title: Catalogue Enrichment from Product Images
summary: Read product photos and back-of-pack images to fill category attributes, mandatory declarations and listing copy for each marketplace, with every value checked before publishing.

seo.title: Catalogue Enrichment from Product Images | VipraTech
seo.description: AI reads product and back-of-pack images to fill marketplace attributes, Legal Metrology declarations and listing copy, with catalogue team approval.

problem.intro: Every new SKU needs a listing on your website, two or three marketplaces and several quick-commerce apps, each with its own template, attribute list and image rules. Catalogue teams type attributes from samples and artwork files, and errors show up as rejected listings or returns.

pain_points.title: Manual attribute entry
pain_points.detail: Fabric, fit, colour, pattern, net quantity, ingredients and shelf life are keyed by hand from samples, artwork PDFs or photos.

pain_points.title: A different template per channel
pain_points.detail: Each marketplace has its own mandatory fields and allowed values, so listings bounce back with rejection reasons.

pain_points.title: Inconsistent attributes
pain_points.detail: The same colour or size is written several different ways, which breaks filters and search on your own site.

pain_points.title: Missing mandatory declarations
pain_points.detail: Net quantity, MRP, manufacturer or importer details and country of origin missing from a listing create compliance risk and delisting.

solution.overview: We build an enrichment pipeline that takes product photos, pack artwork and back-of-pack images and produces a complete, channel-ready listing draft. Vision models identify visual attributes such as colour, pattern, neckline or pack type. OCR and an LLM read pack text for net quantity, MRP, ingredients, veg or non-veg mark, FSSAI licence number, manufacturer details and best-before period. Values are normalised to each channel's allowed list and mapped to its template. Titles and bullets are drafted in your brand voice from facts found on the pack or in your product data only. The catalogue team approves before anything is published.
capabilities: Extracts visual attributes such as colour, pattern, sleeve, neckline, material look and pack format
Reads back-of-pack text for net quantity, MRP, ingredients, allergens, FSSAI licence and manufacturer or importer
Normalises values to each marketplace's allowed list and fills its flat-file template
Drafts titles, bullets and descriptions using only facts found on the pack or in product data
Checks image sets against channel rules for background, count, angles and resolution
Links every attribute to the image region it came from for quick review

workflow.title: Collect product assets
workflow.detail: Photos, pack artwork and back-of-pack images arrive with the SKU code from the PIM, a shared drive or the photo studio.

workflow.title: Extract attributes
workflow.detail: Vision models read visual attributes and OCR with an LLM reads pack text, each value with a confidence score.

workflow.title: Normalise and map
workflow.detail: Values are mapped to each channel's allowed list and template, and missing mandatory fields are listed.

workflow.title: Draft listing copy
workflow.detail: Titles and bullets are drafted from verified facts, in the style each channel expects.

workflow.title: Catalogue review
workflow.detail: The catalogue executive checks low-confidence values, declarations and copy, then approves the listing.

workflow.title: Publish and track
workflow.detail: Approved listings are exported to each channel, and rejection reasons are fed back into the mapping rules.

human_in_the_loop: Catalogue executives approve every listing before it is published and confirm any low-confidence attribute. Statutory declarations and any health, ingredient or performance claim are always checked against the pack image by a person.

compliance_notes: Mandatory declarations under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 are extracted and checked, and the catalogue team confirms them before publishing.
Food listings carry FSSAI labelling details, such as the licence number and veg or non-veg mark, exactly as printed on the pack.

faqs.q: Will it make up product claims?
faqs.a: No. Copy is drafted only from text found on the pack or in your approved product data, so claims such as sugar-free or dermatologically tested appear only if the pack states them. Reviewers see the source for each claim.

faqs.q: Can it handle fashion as well as FMCG?
faqs.a: Yes, with different models. Fashion relies on visual attributes such as pattern, neckline and fit, while FMCG relies more on reading pack text. We pilot on one category first.

faqs.q: Does it work with marketplace flat files?
faqs.a: Yes. We map attributes to each marketplace's current category template and allowed values and produce files or API payloads in that format. When a template changes, the mapping is updated, not the model.

faqs.q: Can it write listings in Hindi?
faqs.a: It can draft Hindi or regional-language descriptions for channels that support them, from the same verified facts. A reviewer fluent in the language approves them.
